location_caveat: Pod bay is a working assumption under Cody's Nov 4 stance (pilot = production, each pod gets a spot). docs/BOTTOM-BAY.md and older CAD place pulse elsewhere — neither is final.
unfitted_state: Service lid + gasket + screws; blank wire plug in sealed pass-through; blank flat skin-contact lands (no open electrode holes); connector sense/ID reads not-fitted; no pulse circuit.
op_architect_vs_strategy: op-architect: keep electrode studs in the design. op-strategy: unfitted bay holds no electrodes. Resolution: reserved stud keep-outs with blank/sealed lands when unfitted; open studs only when fitted. Flagged for op-strategy to confirm.

height.why: Saddle + bay stack sits on the neck side of the strap (fills the ~5.4 mm flat-underside gap). It does not raise the pod lid-top above the strap. Print pod stack above strap unchanged.
height.module_vs_sagitta: MODULE_H=8.0 (+margins) vs sagitta 5.41: any shortfall grows toward neck only, not above strap.
height.hinge_vs_compliant: Measured residual vs R208–221 after R220 saddle is ≤0.32 mm. That does NOT need a hinge. It DOES need compliant/floating electrode contact (spring or elastomer) when fitted — rigid curve alone is not skin contact. Hinge reserved only if later real-neck data shows much larger mismatch.

module.note: placeholder, not a spec — no shock module chosen

driver.note: placeholder, not a spec — no driver board chosen

electrode.note: placeholder, not a spec — reserved geometry only; unfitted skin face is BLANK/FLAT (no electrodes, no open holes, no pulse circuit)
electrode.unfitted: NO electrodes, NO pulse circuit; blank/flat lands; studs/pass-throughs reserved + sealed
electrode.architect_vs_strategy: op-architect: keep electrode studs in the design. op-strategy: unfitted bay holds no electrodes. CAD: blank/flat skin lands + internal sealed stud keep-out. Flagged for op-strategy to resolve.

wire.note: placeholder, not a spec — pod-to-cap harness channel; count/gauge unknown; sized ≥8 conductors for ~4–6 signals/pod (enable, fault, current sense, module-detect, GND, HV rail) + spare; NOT a final pinout

connector_sense_id.note: reserved feature, not a design — connector position with sense/ID so an unfitted bay reads as not-fitted

hw_kill.note: reserved feature, not a design — reachable hardware kill that cuts the driver rail independent of firmware (switch / jumper / fuse-link); accessible via service lid without opening the cell cavity

welfare_tbd.note: seal, isolation distance, and venting come later from the welfare reviewer; adjust MODULE_/DRIVER_/WIRE_ margins and BAY_WALL / GASKET_* — do not hard-code a sealing scheme yet

print.orientation: flat pod-face on bed; concave neck-face UP; light bowl supports

do_not: narrow low bridge between dominant pods
vent slots at the pod-bridge joint
keep: blind groove at cap-to-pod joint as a distinct step (no soft blend)
design_guardrail.note: Pod and saddle changes must not flatten pod tops or add vents or ribs on the bridge. Earlier fixes must not round corners beyond the R3 target.
